Know your basic rights in Taiwan's workplace.

🆓 Free Content
💵 Minimum Wage
• 2026 monthly minimum wage (current): NT$28,590
• Hourly minimum wage: NT$190
• Employers cannot pay below this standard
• Violations: fine of NT$20,000–1,000,000
• Hotline: 1955 (Labor Affairs)

🇭🇰 Hong Kong Employment Ordinance

Know your basic rights in Hong Kong's workplace.

🆓 Free Content
💵 Statutory Minimum Wage
• Minimum wage from May 2026: HK$43.10/hour
• Applies to all employees in Hong Kong
• 468 Rule (from Jan 2026): working 68+ hours in any 4-week period qualifies as continuous contract
• Continuous contract employees get annual leave, sick leave, severance & more
• Enquiries: Labour Dept 2717 1771

🇸🇬 Singapore Employment Act

Know your basic rights in Singapore's workplace.

🆓 Free Content
🏖️ Annual Leave Entitlement
• After 1 year of service: 7 days paid annual leave
• Increases by 1 day per additional year, up to 14 days
• Pro-rated for employees with less than 1 year of service
• Applies to all employees covered by the Employment Act
• Enquiries: MOM 6438 5122

🆓 Free Content
💵 Minimum Wage (Regional)
• Varies by prefecture. Key regions (2024):
• Tokyo: ¥1,163/hour
• Osaka: ¥1,114/hour

• National weighted average: ¥1,055/hour
• Violations: fine up to ¥500,000
• Check: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare

Know your basic rights in Korea's workplace.

🆓 Free Content
💵 Minimum Wage (최저임금)
• 2024 minimum wage: ₩9,860/hour
• 2025 minimum wage: ₩10,030/hour (first time exceeding ₩10,000)
• Monthly equivalent (2025, 209 hrs): ₩2,096,270/month
• Applies to all workers in Korea including foreigners
• Violations: up to 3 years imprisonment or ₩20M fine
• Enquiries: Ministry of Employment and Labor 1350

About Us
Workplace DNA™
👩‍💼
20+ years in HR. Still in the workplace. Still watching.
I spent over two decades in U.S. corporate HR — from entry-level recruiting to senior management consulting.

In that time, I watched countless smart, hard-working people get stuck — not because of lack of ability, but because they didn't know themselves: their natural communication style, how others perceived them, or why their relationship with their manager always felt just slightly off.

I'm also a practitioner of Eastern wisdom. Not fortune-telling — but using thousands of years of frameworks for understanding people to decode the very human patterns that play out in modern workplaces every day.

This platform is where those two things meet.
🎯 Our Mission
Everyone has a unique workplace advantage. Most people just haven't found the right way to see it yet.

Sis's Career Microscope™ exists to provide a career insight tool that is both deep and immediately practical — helping you understand yourself better in the workplace.
🌏 Eastern Wisdom × Real HR Experience
This platform uses Eastern wisdom frameworks — zodiac signs, Chinese animal signs, the Five Elements — as lenses for understanding personality traits and behavioral patterns.

This is not astrology for entertainment. It is a self-awareness system refined over thousands of years, combined with 20+ years of real HR observation, offering a perspective you won't find anywhere else.
💼 Not Self-Help. Self-Awareness.
Most career advice tells you what to do. We think the better path starts with understanding who you are — your natural strengths, your communication style, your blind spots.

When you truly know yourself, the next step becomes obvious.
